purpose: Four higher-risk commodities cocoa beans, cocoa-sugar dry mixes, cocoa mass/cake, and Misri must not inherit contaminant legal maxima by name analogy. Add exact identity standard conditions and method-analyte non-equivalence without changing original legal holds.
source_authority_note: Official FSSAI-hosted current/historical chapter standards are references; original enactment and later amendments prevail. The 2018 Fourteenth Amendment cocoa subject is listed in FSSAI's gazette archive but a signed matching original Gazette paragraph is not presented as authenticated. No commercial lot identity has been provided.

method_sources.title: Determination of cocoa butter in cocoa mass/liquor and cake
Determination of sulphur dioxide in white/refined sugar and Misri

cases.identity_text_compiled_reference_only: Properly fermented and dried whole Theobroma cacao seeds; current published bean quality rows specify maximum moisture 8%, mouldy beans 4% by count, slaty 8%, insect-damaged 2%, germinated and flat 4%.
cases.invalid_ctr_or_method_transfer: Bean-shell/nib/raw matrix is different from cocoa powder's press-cake and dry-fat-free expression. Quality percentages are not lead-CTR maximum.
cases.next_document_request: Obtain bean-batch species/fermentation/drying/incoming quality and original case-specific named CTR lead article; lab method scope for bean matrix.

cases.product_name: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
cases.identity_text_compiled_reference_only: Dry mixtures of cocoa and sugars intended for direct consumption have cocoa powder content and cocoa-butter-type bands. The standard distinguishes sweetened cocoa (not less than 25% cocoa powder), sweetened cocoa mix (not less than 20%), cocoa-flavoured mix (below 20%) and chocolate powder (not less than 32% cocoa powder; 29% on dry matter basis).
cases.invalid_ctr_or_method_transfer: Finished cocoa-and-sugar mixed powder is not pure cocoa powder for lead/contaminant purposes. Product name, cocoa percentage and dry-matter expression need independent proof.
cases.next_document_request: Obtain actual marketed dry-mix SKU/BOM, cocoa powder percentage, moisture and cocoa-fat band, valid subtype; RA to match original operative CTR lead article for composite.

cases.product_name: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
cases.identity_text_compiled_reference_only: Cocoa mass/liquor is ground practically shell-free Theobroma cacao nibs, with or without roasting or changing constituents. Cocoa cake results from fat removal. Product identity table gives cocoa mass cocoa-butter content 47–60% by weight; maximum moisture 10% both mass and cake.
cases.invalid_ctr_or_method_transfer: Cocoa mass, cocoa cake and cocoa powder are distinct articles and not interchangeable for a lead comparator; 47–60% cocoa butter is a FOOD IDENTITY specification, not heavy-metal analytical scope.
cases.next_document_request: Obtain source process state (nibs/mass/liquor/press cake), fat/moisture, original lead CTR article signed applicability and approved NABL lead-in-specific-matrix method. FSSAI 04C.018:2024 is cocoa butter, not lead.

cases.identity_text_compiled_reference_only: Misri is candy obtained from any kind of sugar or palmyrah juice, not defined solely as refined white sugar; compiled standard gives total ash not more than 0.4% and sucrose-equivalent total sugar not less than 98%.
cases.invalid_ctr_or_method_transfer: The Misri identity and quality standards do not establish applicability of a refined-sugar chromium CTR entry. FSSAI 04C.045 and 04C.046:2024 measure sulphur dioxide in Misri, not chromium.
cases.next_document_request: Obtain actual Misri raw sugar/palmyrah source, manufacturing form and controlled specification, original operative 2.1.1 chromium named article; lab approved chromium procedure/LOQ matrix and tested lot.
